headline: Joint meeting on SKSD FY 2026 year-end finances, revised FY 2027 budget, and FY 2027 capital projects for five school buildings.
summary: The School Committee and Town Council will review FY 2026 year-end financial results and fund balance, discuss a revised FY 2027 General Fund Budget, and consider a 5-Year Capital Improvement Plan covering Matunuck Elementary, Peace Dale Elementary, West Kingston Elementary, Broad Rock Middle School, and the Hazard Building.

plain_text:
Tuesday, October 13, 2026
South Kingstown School Committee and Town Council Joint Special Meeting
South Kingstown Town Hall
Town Council Chambers
180 High Street
Wakefield, RI 02879
**************************
Members of the public are welcome and encouraged to attend in person or view the meeting live
on the Town Council YouTube channel or on your local Public Access Television Station.
Such virtual access is being provided only as a convenience and shall not be construed as an
official “location” where access to the meeting is guaranteed. The only way to guarantee
complete access to this meeting is to be physically present thereat.
NOTE: Individuals requesting American Sign Language interpreters or CART service must call the
Town
Clerk’s Office at 401-789-9331 seventy-two (72) hours in advance of the meeting date.
**************************
PUBLIC COMMENT can be done in person at the meeting.
Posted: 10/8/2026
1. 6:00 PM Joint Special Meeting
A. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
B. Land Acknowledgement Statement
C. Discussion re: SKSD FY 2026 District End-of-Year Financial Results - Revenue, Expenses
D. Discussion re: SKSD FY 2026 District End-of-Year Fund Balance
E. Discussion/Potential Action re: SKSD FY 2027 REVISED General Fund Budget
F. Discussion/Potential Action re: FY 2027 Capital Improvement Projects - Recommended 5-Year Plan (Matunuck
Elementary, Peace Dale Elementary, West Kingston Elementary, Broad Rock Middle School, Hazard Building)
2. Public Comments
The order of business maybe altered or suspended at any meeting by a majority of those present. A vote may be taken on any
item on this agenda. Each regular meeting shall continue until such time as all matters on the agenda have been considered and
acted upon, provided, however, that at 10 pm the chair shall call for actions required before adjournment and a subsequent
motion to adjourn. The school committee may go into executive session under Title 42, Ch. 46, Section 5 of the General Laws of
Rhode Island.
The South Kingstown School Department does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy,
gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic
information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors, in accordance with applicable laws and
regulations.
Any changes to this Agenda will be published on the school district’s website, at the two public locations required by R.I. Gen.
Laws § 42-46-6, and transmitted to the Secretary of State’s website at least forty-eight (48) hours in advance of the meeting.
